description: Dive into the world of legal research with our powerful MCP server. Use the 'search_legislation' tool to explore legal topics and statutes from Wikipedia. Extract citations seamlessly with 'extract_citations' for accurate referencing. Need clarity? With zero authentication required, you're just a call away from legal insights.
